answers.Q1: A: look-preserving fixes first; any wash change still needed goes to the owner in a look round (affected pages, before/after, both ramps, phone and desktop, with measured gain per change) and ships only on the owner's relayed approval.
answers.C1: A: the 20 KB proof and the ten-of-ten trial run locally against the CI guard classes; SC-007 reworded; no throwaway branch is pushed.
answers.C2: A as the fallback: when a wash change still looks necessary, the owner is asked in one question with the look round to approve the wash change or keep the look and carry the phone Chromium gap.
